newsitem.title: UK: Argos plans one bln stg acquisitions - FT.
newsitem.headline: Argos plans one bln stg acquisitions - FT.

text.p: British retailer Argos Plc will spend up to one billion pounds ($1.6 billion) on acquisitions and has appointed a full-time director to take on this new responsibility, the Financial Times said on Tuesday.
The paper quoted Argos chief executive Mike Smith as saying the group intended to "increase the pace and urgency" of new business development.
Any acquisition within the next two years was likely to be in Britain and would focus on areas which Argos knew well, such as toys, jewellery and houseware, the paper said.
The paper named former managing director of Argos Distribution, Trevor Green, as the man for the new job.
Earlier on Monday, the group reported a 14 percent hike in annual pre-tax profits to 141.1 million pounds in the year to December 1996, up from 124,4 million in the previous year.
Argos' share price ended eight pence higher at 647.
